slow_response.scope_rationale: The target has a high local robust-z peak, a large level excursion, and an explicitly estimated transient region with an offset. The target history shows positive support for outlier_mad, while the structurally targeted repair_level_shift can use the target's declared region and offset bindings without importing source numeric parameters.
slow_response.risk_rationale: Both operators are destructive: outlier_mad may remove legitimate extremes, and repair_level_shift could alter a sustained regime change. The repair operator is constrained by target-derived public bindings and is specified to preserve persistent level changes; the workflow falls back to identity if no valid repair is detected.

skill_card_scope_coverage.interpretation: not a data-quality problem. Card applicability is keyed on a coarse projection bin whose value behaves like a property of the cohort rather than a recurring Context, so a card learned on one roster cannot match another. This is the same root as E0b's 0/11 coverage and E1-v2's A5_SKILL_CARD_NO_BENEFIT_DEV.

utility_reading.null_control_behaved: on the 4 true-Context Tasks, where the autonomous text says nothing, the two arms are identical (harm 0.0408 both, LOCAL_ACTIVE 2 both). That is the pre-registered null control and it validates that the difference on the false side is attributable to the active clause.

weather_a5a3_autonomous_guidance.standing_pattern: third dataset, same shape: the General layer transfers as behaviour and does not transfer as benefit. post_shift_support_sufficient separated outcomes cleanly on e31, collapsed on T233, and on Weather the deprioritization it licenses costs probes without avoiding harm.

C_coordinate_mismatch.sharper_reading: the overlap test and the localisation test are different questions. Weather fails the first; KDD passes it and still fails the second, because a fraction measured on a 3072-point prefix carries no localisation once it is re-applied to a 240-point window. A repair that edits 93% of the window is not targeted, it is a global shift.

program_binding_contract_audit.conclusion: the Action geometry of repair_level_shift is broken at three independent points. Any Context knowledge conditioning this operator is conditioning an action whose parameters do not describe what it does, so a correct condition cannot rescue it. This supports repairing the Action binding before searching for a third Observation.
what_it_does_not_show: it does not show the Slow Agent or the Harness design is at fault
it does not by itself prove the binding is the ONLY reason Weather showed no benefit; it shows the binding cannot be assumed sound
no headroom is claimed: whether a corrected binding helps is unknown until it is replayed

program_binding_replay.corrected_binding: no parameters; the operator's intrinsic path locates a transient level excursion inside the window it is actually given, per series, and returns identity when there is no legal target

criterion_dependence.note: the answer flips with the criterion, so both are reported and neither is picked by the executor

E1_promotion_gate_gain_ge_material_thres.reading: corrected clearly better on Weather, flat on T233, worse on e31

T0_strong_criterion_gain_and_gain_over_s.reading: no Program headroom for the corrected binding anywhere

geometry_confirmed_corrected.reading: the corrected binding does what the operator promises: it edits a small targeted span instead of most of the window, a 7x to 24x reduction. The geometry repair works; it simply has no measurable downstream utility here.

executor_prediction_errors.prediction: the corrected binding would often return identity
executor_prediction_errors.observed: identity 0 times across 47 Tasks in three cohorts

executor_prediction_errors.prediction: the corrected binding is the repair
executor_prediction_errors.observed: under the frozen strong criterion it yields fewer strong positives than legacy, 1/47 against 10/47

conclusion.legacy: works on e31 by the strong criterion (7/13) but the audit shows it achieves this by subtracting one scalar across a region that is ~89% non-level. Whatever produces that benefit is not level-shift repair, and it does not transfer (2/15 on T233, 1/19 on Weather).
conclusion.corrected: performs the declared repair with correct geometry and has almost no measurable utility on any of the three datasets under the strong criterion
conclusion.combined: this operator family has no demonstrated Program headroom on this data under either binding
conclusion.explains_the_preceding_arc: C1's Observation, the E0b Card and the G1 guidance were all learned on e31, where the benefit came from legacy's accidental broad shift. They were learning to control an action whose e31 benefit came from a mechanism that does not generalise, which is why none of them transferred.

what_it_does_not_show: it does not vindicate the legacy binding: legacy still does not do what its parameters claim, and the audit stands
it does not show the Agentic Harness or the Slow Path is at fault
it does not rule out headroom for this operator on other data or under a different Consumer
